payload.title: hyp implements the shared store: one store holds many Goals
payload.body:
Builds the design recorded in checkpoint-store-design:G-73R704 (selects on checkpoint-store-design-D906CD, checkpoint-store-design-HC4V9T, checkpoint-store-design-H8PJ20, checkpoint-store-design-R21S8R). Every decision is selected there with session e6a35a24 as evidence, and ADR 0020 cites those Results. The candidate is a hyp commit; go test on its base and on the candidate is the instrument. Two-Goal stores land first, so lines 2, 6 and 7 are red on that commit's parent.

May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names that follow AGENTS.md (conventional messages, no AI trailers): the code, ADR 0020, and the spec, glossary, principles, skills/ and README.md text the change makes wrong. The run may push that branch to update its PR, and never merges it.
Read only: recipes/, rubrics/ and every investigations/ tree except checkpoint-store.
Never: commit to main.
Never: replace ~/.local/bin/hyp or ~/.local/share/hyp/hyp-33896ec; write the tree with the installed hyp, and compile the candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit recipes/, rubrics/, any other investigations/ tree, or another repository.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

why: Owner, 2026-11-11: split G1; this tree is the build (G1b). The owner writes its lines.

payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the shared-store design?

why: The build's one question; its candidate will be a hyp commit, added when one exists.
